ImageDescription.value: (NEW SEASON PORTRAIT) Young Stephanie (Danielle Brisebois), with Archie (Carroll O'Connor, front) and his new partner (Martin Balsam, rear, center) are joined by the reg-ulars (left to right, Jason Wingreen, Danny Dayton, Bill Quinn) in "Archie Bunker's Place" (the new title and theme of "All in the Family") to be broadcast SUNDAYS (8:00-8:30 PM, ET) beginning this fall on the CBS Television Network.
